newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks ease, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks ease, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: The Dow industrials backtracked in choppy afternoon trade and tech stocks were mixed as investors digested Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony and took some profits.

The Dow Jones Industrial average, which soared shortly after the market open, was trading up 21 points at 8,082. The New York Stock Exchange lifted its curbs on index-arbitrage trading for the second time during the session.
The long bond was also lower, off 5/32 to 6.43 percent.
The Nasdaq composite was up three points at 1567, off earlier highs. Breadth on the market was nearly evenly mixed.
